candidate: Even with good parents, you could have learned unhealthy self-valuation when people repeatedly praised what you did rather than your inherent worth. That wasn't your flaw. In the process of self-differentiation, we learn to notice when we're making the trade, and we begin holding our ground more when feasible.

edits.why: "Keeping our ground" is not the natural idiom; "holding our ground" is, and the meaning stays the same.
